one_line: Arena-Hard-Auto exposes automatic pairwise judge set from hard arena prompts as an auditable evaluation surface.
Arena-Hard-Auto 把源自竞技场高难提示的自动成对评审集做成可审计的评测面。
why: Harder judge-based alternative to broad chat eval.

title: Problem
问题
html: Primary source: arXiv 2406.11939, submitted June 2024 and revised October 2024, plus the official lmarena repository and Hugging Face release. The problem is continuous curation of challenging open-ended LLM evaluation prompts without repeatedly paying for full human preference collection. Arena-Hard-Auto belongs here as a benchmark-building and automatic pairwise-judge evaluation surface; it is not a ground-truth QA dataset. The data object is a hard user prompt, two model answers, judge configuration, pairwise judgment, and aggregated win-rate score.

一手来源是 arXiv 2406.11939、官方 lmarena 仓库和 Hugging Face release；论文 2024 年 6 月提交、10 月修订。它解决的问题是：开放式 LLM 评测需要持续构造高难度 prompt，但完整人工偏好收集成本很高。收录边界是 benchmark-building 和自动 pairwise judge 评测面，不是有唯一标准答案的 QA 数据集。数据对象是困难用户 prompt、两个模型回答、judge 配置、成对判断和汇总胜率。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Arena-Hard introduces BenchBuilder, an automated pipeline that selects challenging open-ended prompts from crowdsourced conversation data and evaluates models with LLM-as-a-judge. The mechanism is to curate hard prompts, generate candidate model responses, ask a configured judge to compare against a baseline or rival answer, and aggregate win rates with confidence intervals. The closest comparisons are MT-Bench, AlpacaEval-style automatic preference benchmarks, and Chatbot Arena human preference rankings. The direction label is judge/reward meta-evaluation with explicit separability and human-alignment checks.

Arena-Hard 的核心贡献是 BenchBuilder：从众包对话数据中自动筛出困难开放式 prompt，并用 LLM-as-a-judge 评测模型。机制是构造 hard prompt，生成候选模型回答，让配置好的 judge 与 baseline 或对手答案成对比较，再汇总胜率和置信区间。最近参照是 MT-Bench、AlpacaEval 式自动偏好 benchmark 和 Chatbot Arena 人类偏好排名。方向标签是 judge/reward meta-evaluation，并显式检查 separability 与 human-alignment。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: large crowdsourced conversations, prompt-filtering rules, model endpoints, a baseline answer set, judge model, and evaluation config.
  2. Pipeline: BenchBuilder filters hard prompts, models generate answers, gen_judgment.py asks the judge for pairwise preferences, and show_result.py aggregates scores and confidence intervals.
  3. Outputs: prompt set, model answers, judgment records, win rates, and benchmark-quality metrics.
  4. Feedback contract: the judge gives pairwise preference labels; paper-level validation compares benchmark rankings with human preference rankings and separability metrics.
  5. Reproducibility notes: pin Arena-Hard version, prompt set, judge model, baseline, style-control features, temperature, answer budget, and date of model endpoints.

1. 输入：大规模众包对话、prompt 过滤规则、模型 endpoint、baseline answer set、judge 模型和评测配置。
  2. 流程：BenchBuilder 筛选 hard prompt；模型生成答案；gen_judgment.py 调用 judge 做成对偏好判断；show_result.py 汇总分数和置信区间。
  3. 输出：prompt set、模型答案、judgment records、胜率和 benchmark-quality 指标。
  4. 反馈契约：judge 给出 pairwise preference；论文再用与人类偏好排名的一致性和 separability 指标验证 benchmark 质量。
  5. 复现边界：固定 Arena-Hard 版本、prompt set、judge、baseline、style-control features、temperature、回答预算和 endpoint 日期。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The arXiv abstract reports Arena-Hard-Auto as 500 challenging prompts curated by BenchBuilder. It reports 3x higher separation of model performances than MT-Bench, 98.6% correlation with human preference rankings, and an evaluation cost of about $20 for the paper configuration. The row-level evidence is a judge comparison record for a prompt-answer pair, not a factual correctness proof. The boundary is the judge model, baseline, prompt version, style controls, model answer generation settings, and the human preference reference used for validation.

arXiv 摘要报告 Arena-Hard-Auto 由 BenchBuilder 筛出的 500 个困难 prompt 组成。论文配置下，它相对 MT-Bench 有 3 倍模型区分度、与人类偏好排名 98.6% 相关，并且评测成本约 20 美元。单条记录的证据是某个 prompt-answer pair 的 judge comparison，不是事实正确性证明。证据边界是 judge 模型、baseline、prompt 版本、style control、回答生成设置，以及用来验证的人类偏好参照。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior open-ended benchmarks often relied on manually written prompts, limited prompt difficulty, or human evaluation that was expensive to refresh. Arena-Hard changes the construction layer by using crowdsourced data plus LLM filtering to build hard prompts and by evaluating the benchmark itself with separability and human-alignment metrics. What is not new: LLM-as-a-judge and pairwise preference scoring existed before. Reuse checks must inspect prompt provenance, privacy filtering, judge bias, baseline choice, style control, public leaderboard drift, and whether the benchmark version is v0.1, v2.0, or another release.

已有开放式 benchmark 常依赖人工编写 prompt，难度有限，或需要昂贵的人类评测才能刷新。Arena-Hard 的变化是用众包数据加 LLM 过滤构造 hard prompt，并用 separability 和 human-alignment 指标评估 benchmark 本身。不是新的部分包括 LLM-as-a-judge 和成对偏好打分。复用前必须检查 prompt 来源、隐私过滤、judge bias、baseline 选择、style control、公开榜单漂移，以及使用的是 v0.1、v2.0 还是其他版本。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Arena-Hard correctness is preference-relative. A judge win does not certify factual accuracy, safety, or task completion; it only records the configured judge's preference under a prompt and answer pair. Judge models, prompt formatting, response length, markdown style, baseline answers, and endpoint versions can move scores. Public prompts and judgments can be trained on. The current repository advertises newer v2.0 configurations with GPT-4.1/Gemini-2.5, so paper-era scores and current leaderboard scores must not be mixed without version labels.

Arena-Hard 的正确性是偏好相对的。judge 胜出不证明事实正确、安全或任务真正完成，只说明在某个 prompt-answer pair 下配置好的 judge 更偏好一方。judge 模型、prompt 格式、回答长度、markdown 风格、baseline answer 和 endpoint 版本都会移动分数。公开 prompts 和 judgments 也会进入训练。当前仓库已有 v2.0 配置和 GPT-4.1/Gemini-2.5 judge，不能把论文时期分数和当前榜单混用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Arena-Hard as a reference for building hard open-ended judge benchmarks and for auditing judge-based evaluation. Preserve prompt ID, source/provenance, benchmark version, baseline answer, candidate answer, judge model, judge prompt, style controls, random seed or retry policy, pairwise label, confidence interval, and leaderboard date. For atlas curation it is useful because it treats benchmark quality itself as measurable through separability and agreement with human preference.

Arena-Hard 可作为构造困难开放式 judge benchmark 的参考，也适合审计基于 judge 的评测。复用时保留 prompt ID、来源、benchmark 版本、baseline answer、candidate answer、judge 模型、judge prompt、style control、随机种子或重试策略、pairwise label、置信区间和榜单日期。对 atlas 来说，它的价值在于把 benchmark 质量本身也变成可测对象：看 separability 和与人类偏好的 agreement。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Keep three labels separate: prompt difficulty, judge preference, and factual/task correctness. Arena-Hard is strong when the downstream question is model ranking under open-ended prompts; it is weak as row-level truth verification. Always read the repository version notes before citing scores, because the active benchmark has evolved beyond the 2024 paper configuration.
要分开三个标签：prompt 难度、judge 偏好、事实/任务正确性。Arena-Hard 擅长回答开放式 prompt 下的模型排序问题，不适合作为逐条 truth verification。引用分数前一定看仓库版本说明，因为当前 active benchmark 已经超出 2024 论文配置。
